mapper.sql: t.* , version.version_no AS version_no , from_task.task_no AS from_task_no , from_task.op_code AS from_op_code , from_task.op_name AS from_op_name , to_task.task_no AS to_task_no , to_task.op_code AS to_op_code , to_task.op_name AS to_op_name

FROM aps_task_dep t LEFT JOIN aps_version version ON version.id = t.version_id AND version.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN aps_task from_task ON from_task.id = t.from_task_id AND from_task.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN aps_task to_task ON to_task.id = t.to_task_id AND to_task.deleted = 0
